Celtic Prepare for Falkirk Clash as Manager Martin O'Neill Addresses Squad and Tactics

04 Nov 2026, 08:29 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily Editorial Desk · Source: www.bbc.com

2 min read

Upcoming Fixture and Match Details

Celtic are preparing to face Falkirk in an upcoming Premiership match scheduled for Sunday at 13:00 GMT. Celtic enter the fixture holding a four-point lead in the domestic standings, with manager Martin O'Neill noting the opportunity to potentially extend that advantage to seven points.

Managerial Comments on Squad and Tactics

Ahead of the match, manager Martin O'Neill addressed media reports and tactical discussions following comments made by team captain Callum McGregor. McGregor reportedly pointed out that the team lacks a defined profile for attacking positions, noting that strikers are frequently deployed out wide, which can result in chaotic matches lacking control.

O'Neill expressed total agreement with the captain's observations. According to the manager:

  • Player Positions: O'Neill discussed players adjusting to new roles, noting that squad members are still getting to know each other.
  • Late Arrivals: The manager highlighted that several players arrived late and did not complete a full pre-season with the club, meaning integration will take time.
  • Domestic Standing: While pleased with the team's domestic form so far, O'Neill emphasized that a four-point lead is minimal at this stage of the season.

Team News and Opposition

Addressing external narratives, O'Neill pushed back against suggestions of internal division, stating the club is performing fine. Regarding the upcoming opposition, O'Neill expects a challenging encounter against a Falkirk side that has improved significantly following a slow start to the campaign.

On the team selection front, Celtic will be without Auston Trusty for Sunday's match, as the player has returned to the United States to handle a family matter.

Verification

Supporters and followers can verify official team announcements, match updates, and squad availability through Celtic's official club channels and authorized sports broadcasting networks covering the Scottish Premiership.
